purpose: Map legacy candidate/tool/cluster metadata to concrete ProgramBench task roots, source roots, or benchmark fixture roots before hydration and replay execution.
acceptance: exact name resolves to task and source roots
alias table matches are marked alias-only
multiple exact matches are not treated as resolved
binary-only matches do not become hydrated-ready roots
resolved paths must stay inside allowed ProgramBench roots
symlink escape candidates are excluded by the source index
policy: Alias-only and binary-only matches require confirmation before hydration.
Fuzzy or multiple matches cannot become HYDRATED_READY.
Hydration may consume only confirmed task/source root resolutions.
does_not_prove: Does not prove Batch 001 can replay yet; current result shows all 10 candidates are blocked by multiple local matches that require root disambiguation.
